title: California's Adam's Law (SB 1119) AI chatbot child-safety duties take effect
summary: Core requirements of SB 1119, signed by Gov. Newsom on September 10, 2026, take effect July 1, 2027, requiring companion-chatbot operators to run child risk assessments, cap minors' sessions, default to limited memory, and provide crisis-response resources.

title: Azure DevOps issuer in Workload Identity Federation service connections retires
summary: Microsoft will retire the Azure DevOps issuer (vstoken.dev.azure.com) for Workload Identity Federation service connections on July 1, 2027, standardizing on the Microsoft Entra issuer; affected pipelines must convert before then.

sources.title: Retirement of Azure DevOps issuer in Workload identity federation service connections
Workload identity federation Azure DevOps issuer retirement

title: Nvidia Rubin Ultra GPU targeted for second half of 2027
summary: Nvidia's public GPU roadmap has Rubin Ultra, the enhanced follow-on to the 2026 Rubin generation, arriving in the second half of 2027, with the Feynman architecture positioned after it.

sources.title: Nvidia announces Rubin GPUs in 2026, Rubin Ultra in 2027, Feynman also added to roadmap

title: Louisiana App Store Accountability Act takes effect
summary: Louisiana's App Store Accountability Act, which places age-verification and parental-consent obligations on app stores and developers, was delayed by one year via HB 977 (signed May 15, 2026) and now takes effect July 1, 2027.

sources.title: Louisiana Delays App Store Accountability Effective Date to July 2027
Louisiana Delays App Store Accountability Effective Date to July 2027

title: TSMC's second Arizona fab targets N3 volume production
summary: TSMC's second Arizona fab, with equipment installation underway in Q3 2026, is targeting volume production on its N3 (3nm) process technology in the second half of 2027.

sources.title: TSMC brings its most advanced chipmaking node to the US yet
TSMC accelerates production timeline for new Arizona factory

title: TSMC targets 2027 mass production for A16 (1.6nm) and N2P nodes
summary: TSMC's roadmap has its N2P and A16 (1.6nm, backside power delivery) process nodes reaching high-volume manufacturing in the second half of 2027, following N2's late-2025 production start; N2X is also expected to enter mass production in 2027.

sources.title: TSMC's 2nm N2 process node enters production this year, A16 and N2P arriving next year

title: ICML 2027
summary: The International Conference on Machine Learning returns to South America July 4-9, 2027; icml.cc's own Future Meetings page confirms the region but the exact host city has not yet been officially announced.

title: Black Hat USA 2027
summary: Black Hat's flagship US conference and trainings return to the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas.
location: Mandalay Bay Convention Center, Las Vegas, NV
